key.name: pin-key
key.description: Toggles the focused window's geometry pin. Side-tiled windows become floating at the same size and position. Pins release when display layout changes or application size limits no longer permit the saved rectangle.

key.name: above-key
key.description: Toggles always-on-top on the focused window.

key.name: unpin-all-key
key.description: Unpins every currently pinned window at once.
